## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `security` · `priority:p1` · `domain:services` · `area:access`, into `pm:queue`. Measure first, then one shared door for the raw-host families

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T05:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1 `security`:** a session ADR-0069 holds out of protected resources (enforced MFA not enrolled, or an expired password) may still be answered as an ordinary signed-in caller by families that never consult the gate. That is the "half-authenticated session cannot read data" line of the ADR. Reachability is not measured yet, so the first acceptance item comes first.
- **Direction, as the card's acceptance, with three bindings:**
  1. **Measure first.** On a booted composition served the way a deployment serves it, each family with a policy-held session. A family already gated in front is dropped, with the measurement as its evidence.
  2. **One door.** Reached families consult the gate through what `@objectstack/core` already has (`evaluateAuthGate`, `isAuthGateAllowlisted`), as `enforceAuth` does. If a composed helper is added, it is one function beside `shouldDenyAnonymous`, named in the claim. ⛔ No new copy of the allow-list rule, and ⛔ no per-family re-implementation.
  3. **Serial on shared files.** `settings-routes.ts` is in flight under #23142 (the anonymous floor), and `storage-routes.ts` under #23143 (PR #23172). Those two rows land after their cards close, and may compose with the floor #23142 mounts. The census, the core door and the other three families do not wait.
  - The `plugin-sharing` row is seat 1's region and is declared there first, as the card says.
  - **Pins:** per family, a held session is refused with the REST seam's status and `code`; an un-held signed-in session is unchanged; a CORS preflight is unchanged.
- **Disclosure:** the card stays at function level, and so does this note. Any route-level reading goes to the lane's private channel.
- This tightens a door, so it does not escalate.
- Triage: lands in the reached families' route files plus, at most, one `@objectstack/core` helper (`domain:services`); rationale: every transport seam reads the gate.

Claim: PM loop round 8 · 2026-10-13T06:21Z
Session: `session_01FzQy26KznSa5j2gnf3AzsE`
Account: `zhuangjianguo` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-23178-auth-gate-raw-host-families`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23178`
Domain: `domain:services`
Seat: `domain:services#2` (seat post #21118)
File surface: the reached families' registrars and the resolvers that read their caller's session: `packages/services/service-i18n/src/i18n-service-plugin.ts`, `packages/services/service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-routes.ts`, `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-routes.ts` with `settings-service-plugin.ts`, and `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts` (only after PR #23172 merges); their tests; one `.changeset/23178-*.md`. `@objectstack/core` is read, not edited: the door calls its existing exports. A family outside this list, or a new export anywhere, means stop and report before editing.
Container & model: `M (measure on a booted composition, then one gate consultation across up to five families, with per-family pins)`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack: "no path-derived mandate … The tier stays the PM's per-card judgment call"`
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — a session ADR-0069 holds out of protected resources is refused by families that answered it; core's existing exports only, no published schema or export moves.
Responsibility: the raw-host route families' own caller-context resolvers (the platform's own code) never read the session's `authGate` | none for these families: REST `enforceAuth`, the runtime dispatcher and the MCP plugin gate their own doors only | a signed-in user held by enforced MFA or an expired password; reach not yet measured (the card's first acceptance item)
Thread-read: 6139290291
Serial constraints cleared: no `pm:dispatched` claim declares these files, and of the 13 open PRs only PR #23172 (#23143, in the merge queue) touches one of them, `storage-routes.ts`; that row waits for its merge. `settings-routes.ts` is free: #23142 landed as `20949e7a7c` today. #23174 (`pm:blocked`, p2) shares `storage-routes.ts`, `settings-routes.ts` and `i18n-service-plugin.ts`. Fold-or-serial: **serial**, not fold. Gate ① fails: it is a different defect and a different fix (5xx message text, not the session gate). #23174 goes after this card. `share-link-routes.ts` is outside the C2/C3 epic's declared territory (#6021 §3), but it is declared to #15194 per triage's binding.

Claim amendment · `domain:services` seat 2 · `session_01FzQy26KznSa5j2gnf3AzsE` · 2026-10-13T06:56Z, under claim `6139594843`. ⛔ Not a new claim. Same branch; `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is unchanged.

The dev's measurement (`os-dev-report` `6140038315`; route-level readings kept off GitHub under the lane's disclosure rule) answered the card's first acceptance item. The seat's rulings on its three stops:

- **Scope.**
  - This card keeps the four reached families in its claim: settings, storage, datasource admin and share links.
  - i18n is dropped: the measurement shows it gated in front, because the dispatcher plugin mounts the same three routes ahead of the i18n plugin's own mount. That measurement is its evidence.
  - The file surface grows by one reached family in this lane, with the same raw-mount shape: `plugin-webhooks`' outbox redeliver handler (`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/webhook-outbox-plugin.ts`, plus `redeliver-guard.ts` if the door lands there), with its tests and the changeset.
  - The reached families in `domain:cli` packages go to one family card filed by this seat: REST's direct-mount registrars, the runtime dispatcher plugin's declared-endpoint fallback, and cloud-connection's raw-app plugins. They are not edited here.
- **Door shape:** existing `@objectstack/core` exports only (`evaluateAuthGate`, or `normalizeAuthGate` plus `isAuthGateAllowlisted` as `enforceAuth` does), consulted once at each family's door, with the refusal written through that family's own error envelope. That is a call of the shared decision, not a re-implementation of it. Carrying the posture through a family's own session resolver is in scope. If that changes an exported declaration, the dev stops.
- **Capability-token routes inside these families** (storage's raw transfer, share-link resolve and messages): a held session is refused there too. It only tightens, and it matches the dispatcher's twin of the same share-link routes. Exempting them would widen the allow-list, which is not this seat's to do.

Serial constraints, re-read: none of the 13 open PRs touches `plugin-webhooks/src`, `admin-routes.ts` or `share-link-routes.ts`. PR #23172 (#23143) merged as `3d6392f1fa`, so `storage-routes.ts` is free after the dev merges `origin/main`.

Seat ruling on the dev's second stop (`os-dev-report` `6141011287`, PR #23200 at `f6867e7125`) · `domain:services` seat 2 · `session_01FzQy26KznSa5j2gnf3AzsE` · 2026-10-13T07:59Z, under claim `6139594843` and amendment `6140090530`.

PR #23200 consults the gate at three families' doors: datasource admin, share links (token routes included) and the webhook redeliver handler. Settings and storage were left untouched, because their doors can read the posture only through an exported type (`SettingsContext`, `StorageUploadSession`).

- **Storage:** option B, in PR #23200. The package-internal `composeStorageRoutes` already binds every storage gate for both the plugin's own mount and the host door `mountStorageRoutes`, so it binds the posture too. No exported declaration changes; the built `.d.ts` diff is checked.
- **Settings:** carved out of this card's remaining work. Its documented host door, the exported `registerSettingsRoutes` with a host's own resolver, can only be reached by declaring an optional `authGate` on the exported `SettingsContext`, the dev's option A. The seat reads a new field on an exported type as widening the public surface, so `Clause-②` is `yes`, and that is spec-lane work. Once PR #23200 lands, the seat releases the settings row with a `Release:` line and `pm:retriage`, carrying the dev's A / B / C analysis. A package-internal second entry point for the plugin's own mount (option B for settings) is not taken: it would leave the public registrar weaker than the plugin's mount, the class of defect this card exists for, and a declared field would replace it.
- **PR form:** line 1 becomes `Refs #23178 (datasource admin, share links, webhook redeliver, storage)`, a partial landing. Line 2 stays `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. PR #23200 owes a contract-review-tier review before the queue.
